results.statement: For exact rank three A=RMR^T, R^TR=I3, D=|det M|, physical row leverage c_i and a=A_ii!=0, ||p_Q||inf <=128 [c_i D |a|]^-1/4. Exact identity |pdet_2(A/A_ii)|=c_iD/|a|.
If A_ii=0 and every other physical spectral row has transverse leverage <=1/2 relative to u_i, then ||p_Q||inf <=3*2^(4/3)(c_iD)^-1/3, with continuous C0 density.

A target-valid family with exact nonzero spectrum {-kappa,1,kappa} has two exact-null heavy anchors, macroscopic aggregate anchor-star mass >1/2, while all diagonals, all 2x2 principal determinants and all individual anchor-star leaves can tend to zero. It is not a QFORM counterexample; it refutes fixed-minor/nonzero-pivot shortcut extraction. Rerooting pays the same family by <=5.103484443395882.
